why my ai app works locally but not in production

Quick thread 🧵
Why does an AI-built app work locally but break in production?
Because production is a different environment, and the things your laptop quietly faked are now gone.
The database was a local file that resets on redeploy.
Your secrets lived in a `.env` that never reached the server.
